items.name: Blåknapp
items.observations: Slender branched stems with opposite, entire lanceolate stem leaves; elongated mostly unlobed basal leaves; compact, rounded blue-violet capitula on long stalks, accompanied by green bud-heads and a fibrous root crown. The overall field silhouette and inflorescence placement are consistent with Succisa pratensis.
items.limitations: Some illustrated florets suggest five petals, while authentic Succisa pratensis has four-lobed tubular corollas. This is a nontrivial close-up inaccuracy and the image must not be relied on as diagnostic evidence. Overall species habit is recognizable at field-guide scale; compare licensed reference photographs before identification. Some inflorescences appear overly regular and the tallest head slightly exaggerated.
items.technicalVerification: Original RGBA PNG source converted directly to exact-alpha WebP without chroma-key extraction. Verified 1024x1536, 499202 bytes, VP8X alpha, SHA256 and Git blob SHA. Alpha min 0 max 254, black/white previews inspected.
